kind_of_no: seasonal-site park with no price indicator: no website, no booking engine, not on RV Life or Good Sam
why: Google Maps 'Dirks Resort Campground' (452A Ave, Madison SD 57042; 4.2/27, campground, (605) 270-2151, no website - the panel offers 'Add website'; read 2026-11-22) is the only presence. Its reviews describe a seasonal park: a 2025 review is 'wrapping up our 5th season here ... What started as a "let's just try it out" seasonal site', a mid-2026 review is 'excited about having a permanent camping spot', another reviewer has been there '6 years'; none mentions a nightly stay. No posted rate or nightly sale anywhere: not in RV Life's index (Algolia bbox 43.90..44.05 N, -97.25..-97.00 and a 'Dirks' query, 2026-11-22), not in the Good Sam directory cache, no Campspot/Hipcamp/Facebook page found by web search; only unclaimed directory records (allcampsandparks, rvcampgroundhq, superpages/yellowpages; pinecliffresort.net is the known content farm). Fails the private price indicator and long-stay test 2 (a mostly seasonal park needs a posted nightly rate or a booking site).
name: Dirks Resort Campground
flags: The lead says Lake Madison, but the park is on the EAST SHORE OF LAKE HERMAN, about 3 km west of Madison (Google point 43.97587,-97.15895; address 23515 452A Ave). Esri World Imagery crop (sat.py, 900 m frame, rendered, 2026-11-22): about 60 RVs packed in curving rows between 452A Ave and a band of trees and lake houses on the Lake Herman shore, with a pool/community building - consistent with a seasonal park. Waterfront not audited (skipped).
Not a duplicate: nearest DB entry is 5733 Lake Herman State Park, about 1.4 km NW (a separate GFP park); 5829 Prairie Village is ~3.5 km N. No Dirks entry in campgrounds.json.
An obituary found by web search says the current campground was developed on Lake Herman in 2015 (an older 'Dirks' Resort' on Lake Herman dates from 1969); not needed for the decision.
If AWH wants it reconsidered, the only route is a phone call to (605) 270-2151 to ask whether nightly RV sites are sold and at what rate - not attempted (no calls).
